name: lrim_graph_benchmark
description: LRIM Graph Benchmark evaluates model ability to reason about structured graph data and answer questions that require understanding graph topology, node/edge attributes, and multi-hop relationships. Tasks present graph instances and associated queries designed to probe compositional and relational reasoning over graphs. Benchmarks measure correctness of graph-focused reasoning rather than purely language understanding.
reputation: A niche, research-oriented benchmark with limited adoption to date, mainly used in smaller graph-reasoning studies.
